Thank You for Your Application!

Dear {applicant_name},

Thank you for applying for the position of {designation} (Job Opening: {job_opening}). We have received your application and our recruitment team will review your profile shortly.

Your Application Details:

Reference Number: {doc.name}

Email: {recipient_email}

Phone: {phone}

Country: {country}

Status: {status}

What Happens Next?

  • Our HR team will review your application
  • If shortlisted, you will be contacted for the next round
  • You can track your application status through our portal

If you have any questions, feel free to reach us at hr@yourcompany.com.

Best regards,
Your Recruitment Team

""" # Send Email frappe.sendmail( recipients=[recipient_email], subject=subject, message=message ) # Add comment on Job Applicant doc.add_comment("Comment", f"Acknowledgment email sent to {recipient_email}") else: frappe.log_error(f"No email found for Job Applicant: {doc.name}", "Email Missing")

for row in doc.staffing_details:
    # Skip if designation missing
    if not row.designation:
        frappe.msgprint(f"Row {row.idx}: Designation missing, skipping job creation.", indicator='orange')
        continue

    # Check if Job Opening already exists for this Staffing Plan row
    existing_opening = frappe.db.exists("Job Opening", {
        "reference_name": doc.name,
        "custom_row_index": row.idx
    })

    if not existing_opening:
        try:
            # Prepare Job Opening details
            job_opening = frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "Job Opening",
                "job_title": row.designation,
                "status": "Open",
                "department": doc.department or None,
                "company": doc.company or None,
                "designation": row.designation,
                "employment_type":row.employment_type,
                "location":row.location,
                "custom_experienceyrs":row.min_experience_req,
                "staffing_plan": doc.name,
                "description": row.job_description,
                "expected_experience": row.min_experience_req or 0,
                "vacancies": row.number_of_positions or 0,
                "upper_range":row.estimated_cost_per_position or 0,
                "reference_name": doc.name,
                "custom_row_index": row.idx,
                "custom_estimated_cost_per_position": row.estimated_cost_per_position or 0,
                "custom_from_date": doc.from_date,
                "custom_to_date": doc.to_date,
                "custom_created_from_staffing_plan": 1
            })
            
            # Insert Job Opening
            job_opening.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

            # 🔹 Save newly created Job Opening ID back into staffing_details row
            frappe.db.set_value(
                "Staffing Plan Detail",   # child table doctype name
                row.name,             # child row unique ID
                "job_id",             # field in child table where job name should be stored
                job_opening.name      # Job Opening name
            )

            frappe.msgprint(f"✅ Job Opening '{job_opening.name}' created and linked to Row {row.idx} ({row.designation})")

        except Exception as e:
            frappe.log_error(f"Error creating Job Opening for Staffing Plan {doc.name}, Row {row.idx}: {str(e)}")
            frappe.msgprint(f"❌ Failed to create Job Opening for Row {row.idx}: {str(e)}", indicator='red')

    else:
        frappe.msgprint(f"ℹ️ Job Opening already exists for Row {row.idx} ({row.designation})", indicator='blue')

name: Auto-fix Duplicate Company Abbreviation
script:
"""
ERPNext Server Script for Company Doctype
Event: Before Save

This script handles duplicate abbreviations for both full form and quick add dialog.
It patches the validation to allow our changes to work.
"""

# Ensure abbreviation exists (in case it's not generated yet)
if not doc.abbr and doc.company_name:
    # Generate abbreviation from company name
    doc.abbr = "".join([s[0].upper() for s in doc.company_name.split()[:3]])
    if not doc.abbr:  # Fallback if company name is empty
        doc.abbr = "COMP"

# Store original abbreviation
original_abbr = doc.abbr

# For new documents
if doc.is_new():
    counter = 1
    
    # Keep checking until we find a unique abbreviation
    while frappe.db.exists('Company', {'abbr': doc.abbr}):
        doc.abbr = f"{original_abbr}{counter}"
        counter += 1
        
        # Safety limit
        if counter > 100:
            frappe.throw(f"Unable to find unique abbreviation after 100 attempts for base: {original_abbr}")
            break
    
    # Show notification if changed
    if doc.abbr != original_abbr:
        frappe.msgprint(
            f"Abbreviation '{original_abbr}' already exists. Auto-changed to '{doc.abbr}'",
            indicator='orange',
            alert=True
        )
    
    # Set a flag to skip the standard validation
    doc.flags.ignore_abbr_validation = True

# For existing documents where abbreviation is being changed
else:
    old_abbr = frappe.db.get_value('Company', doc.name, 'abbr')
    
    # Only check if abbreviation actually changed
    if doc.abbr and doc.abbr != old_abbr:
        counter = 1
        
        # Check if new abbreviation exists (excluding current company)
        while frappe.db.exists('Company', {'abbr': doc.abbr, 'name': ['!=', doc.name]}):
            doc.abbr = f"{original_abbr}{counter}"
            counter += 1
            
            # Safety limit
            if counter > 100:
                frappe.throw(f"Unable to find unique abbreviation after 100 attempts for base: {original_abbr}")
                break
        
        # Show notification if changed
        if doc.abbr != original_abbr:
            frappe.msgprint(
                f"Abbreviation '{original_abbr}' already exists. Changed to '{doc.abbr}'",
                indicator='orange',
                alert=True
            )
        
        # Set a flag to skip the standard validation
        doc.flags.ignore_abbr_validation = True

name: staffing plan to job opening with both updates
script:
# Refresh the document to get latest child table data
doc.reload()

for row in doc.staffing_details:
    # Skip if designation missing
    if not row.designation:
        frappe.msgprint(f"Row {row.idx}: Designation missing, skipping.", indicator='orange')
        continue
    
    # Try multiple ways to find existing job opening
    existing_opening_name = None
    
    # Method 1: Check if job_id field has value and verify it exists
    if row.job_id and frappe.db.exists("Job Opening", row.job_id):
        existing_opening_name = row.job_id
        frappe.msgprint(f"📋 Row {row.idx}: Found existing Job Opening via job_id: {existing_opening_name}")
    
    # Method 2: If no valid job_id, search by designation and staffing plan
    if not existing_opening_name:
        existing_job = frappe.db.get_value("Job Opening", {
            "designation": row.designation,
            "staffing_plan": doc.name,
            "status": "Open"
        }, "name")
        
        if existing_job:
            existing_opening_name = existing_job
            frappe.msgprint(f"🔍 Row {row.idx}: Found existing Job Opening via search: {existing_opening_name}")
            # Update the job_id field for future reference
            frappe.db.set_value("Staffing Plan Detail", row.name, "job_id", existing_job)
            # Refresh the row data
            row.job_id = existing_job
    
    # If we found an existing job opening, UPDATE it
    if existing_opening_name:
        # 🔄 UPDATE EXISTING JOB OPENING
        try:
            update_data = {
                "job_title": row.designation,
                "designation": row.designation,
                "employment_type": row.employment_type,
                "location": row.location,
                "custom_experienceyrs": row.min_experience_reqyrs,
                "description": row.job_description,
                "vacancies": row.number_of_positions or 0,
                "upper_range": row.estimated_cost_per_position or 0,
                "department": doc.department or None,
                "company": doc.company or None,
                "staffing_plan": doc.name,
                "currency": row.currency or None,
                "custom_opportunity": doc.get("custom_opportunity") or None
            }
            
            # Remove None values to avoid issues
            update_data = {k: v for k, v in update_data.items() if v is not None}
            
            frappe.db.set_value("Job Opening", existing_opening_name, update_data)
            
            frappe.msgprint(f"🔄 Row {row.idx}: Job Opening '{existing_opening_name}' updated for ({row.designation})", indicator='blue')
            
        except Exception as e:
            frappe.log_error(
                message=f"Job Opening: {existing_opening_name}\nStaffing Plan: {doc.name}\nRow: {row.idx}\nError: {str(e)}",
                title=f"Update Failed - Row {row.idx}"
            )
            frappe.msgprint(f"❌ Row {row.idx}: Failed to update - {str(e)}", indicator='red')
    
    else:
        # ✨ CREATE NEW JOB OPENING
        try:
            job_opening = frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "Job Opening",
                "job_title": row.designation,
                "status": "Open",
                "department": doc.department or None,
                "company": doc.company or None,
                "designation": row.designation,
                "employment_type": row.employment_type,
                "location": row.location,
                "custom_experienceyrs": row.min_experience_reqyrs,
                "staffing_plan": doc.name,
                "description": row.job_description,
                "vacancies": row.number_of_positions or 0,
                "upper_range": row.estimated_cost_per_position or 0,
                "currency": row.currency or None,
                "custom_opportunity": doc.get("custom_opportunity") or None
            })
            
            # Set flags to bypass validation
            job_opening.flags.ignore_validate = True
            job_opening.flags.ignore_mandatory = True
            
            # Insert Job Opening
            job_opening.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            
            # Save Job Opening ID back to staffing_details row AND update current row object
            frappe.db.set_value("Staffing Plan Detail", row.name, "job_id", job_opening.name)
            row.job_id = job_opening.name  # Update the in-memory row object
            
            frappe.msgprint(f"✅ Row {row.idx}: Job Opening '{job_opening.name}' created for ({row.designation})")
            
        except Exception as e:
            frappe.log_error(
                message=f"Staffing Plan: {doc.name}\nRow: {row.idx}\nDesignation: {row.designation}\nError: {str(e)}",
                title=f"Creation Failed - Row {row.idx}"
            )
            frappe.msgprint(f"❌ Row {row.idx}: Failed to create - {str(e)}", indicator='red')

frappe.msgprint(f"🎯 Processing completed for {len(doc.staffing_details)} rows", indicator='green')
